exposure: severe maternal morbidities related to pregnancy
cohort: Women admitted to a tertiary care Italian public hospital over a 10-year period
finding: A combination of management-based criteria identified 151 cases of severe maternal morbidities, most frequently major obstetric hemorrhage and hypertensive disorders, and these were associated with pre-term birth, caesarean section, sub-saharan African origin, increased maternal mortality and stillbirth, and increased hospital expenditures.
